sources.title: OpenAI DevDay
sources.reflection: Attendance selection and registration rules describe an event opportunity. They do not establish a scientific review, comparative national ranking, or endorsement of the three pillars.

sources.title: Codex speed
sources.reflection: Codex Fast credit consumption and API Fast token prices use different units. The observed host service tier is default; no speed or context guarantee is inferred.

sources.title: GPT 6 Astra model
sources.reflection: The published model context capacity is a product specification. A host configuration entry does not prove how much history an individual task retained.

sources.title: NIST uncertainty propagation
sources.reflection: First order uncertainty propagation includes covariance. Its assumptions and units must accompany any numerical result; a software calculation is not an instrument calibration.

sources.title: BIPM SI Brochure
sources.reflection: Quantity dimensions, units, and dimensionless types constrain interpretable equations. Natural unit conventions need explicit conversion assumptions.

sources.title: PROV ontology
sources.reflection: Entities, activities, agents, and derivation relations support provenance descriptions. A graph records attributed provenance rather than verifying the truth of every assertion.

sources.title: Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2
sources.reflection: Issuer, holder, and subject roles are distinct. Conforming JSON structure is insufficient to establish a verified signature, trustworthy issuer, or legal identity.

sources.title: DID Core
sources.reflection: A decentralized identifier and its method describe technical control and resolution semantics. A fabricated identifier in a fixture has no live registration or personhood implication.

sources.title: SHACL
sources.reflection: Constraint validation can check an RDF data graph against shapes. This remaster will disable remote imports and use inline controlled fixtures.

sources.title: JSON Canonicalization Scheme
sources.reflection: Canonical serialization has a defined number and string domain. A byte digest supports fixity within that domain and cannot prove anonymization or proposition truth.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2
sources.reflection: Accessible structure and visual inspection can improve artifacts. They do not substitute for affected user evaluation or prove complete accessibility.

sources.title: Center for Open Science preregistration
sources.reflection: A dated analysis plan makes later deviations inspectable. Its existence does not demonstrate that an experiment ran or that a causal claim is correct.

sources.title: Erdos problem 242
sources.reflection: The displayed distinct denominator variant requires n greater than two. The finite witness search and two constructive subfamilies will be labelled separately from the unresolved universal conjecture.

sources.title: Elsholtz and Tao unit fractions
sources.reflection: Prior mathematical work provides context for unit fraction decompositions. Reusing known constructions gives no new theorem credit to this phase.

sources.title: Recent unit fraction parametrization
sources.reflection: A recent parametrization is a research claim to assess. The current phase does not promote it, or a finite search, to an accepted universal proof.

sources.title: Landauer principle with finite size corrections
sources.reflection: Physical information erasure statements require stated systems, thermodynamic assumptions, and units. They do not supply an experimentally established law of psyche or a consciousness detector.

sources.title: Horndeski theory review
sources.reflection: A field theory comparison requires a defined action, degrees of freedom, and stability assumptions. Symbolic resemblance does not establish equivalence.

sources.title: General relativity as an effective field theory
sources.reflection: Low energy effective descriptions have domains and expansion assumptions. A proposed extra tensor must specify its dynamics and observable consequences.

sources.title: Te Mana Raraunga resources
sources.reflection: Cultural data authority should be represented as a specific governance relationship. Ownership of a local file does not confer authority to speak for a community.

sources.title: SymPy documentation
sources.reflection: Trusted symbolic expressions can test algebraic identities and exact rational arithmetic. Untrusted strings will not be evaluated.

legacy.v54: Not located in bounded exact Drive name searches or inspected main root; no content claim
legacy.interpretation: The v33 opening already distinguishes symbolic hopes from validated physics and legal personhood. Later narrative claims remain attributed historical context. Current repository test receipts do not revalidate those claims.

gmail.coverage: Accessible matches for the recorded sender queries; not a claim about deleted or unmatched messages.
